title: fix(git): commit panel notice pins to the top and hides the tree
body:
Mechanical follow-up to card jxayli; the fix is already written and tested. Do not redo it.

Bug: any notice in the commit panel (a commit's '[main 1a2b3c4] subject' line, an error) made the Git Changes window show only that line. egui's ScrollArea pins to the top-left of free space, so inside the panel's bottom-up ui it sat at the top of the window, the buttons and message box were laid out above it off-screen, and the panel's reported height left the tree no room. Present since 84ac015.

Fix: commit 72ce727 on branch card/jxayli in this repository (src/git_history/commit.rs only: measure the notice text, allocate an exact rect at the bottom, show the ScrollArea in a top-down child; plus the test a_notice_adds_a_few_lines_to_the_panel_not_the_whole_window).

Steps, in your worktree:
1. git cherry-pick 72ce727
2. Amend the message so its trailer block ends with your own 'Card: <this card id>' line (keep the Co-Authored-By line; replace 'Card: jxayli').
3. cargo test --target-dir target/agent git_history::commit::tests  (all pass; the notice test is the guard)
4. cargo fmt --check
5. foreman kanban integrate <id>; foreman kanban wait <id> --timeout 1800; on exit 3 read the reason with foreman kanban list --json, fix, resubmit.

If 72ce727 is unreachable (branch card/jxayli gone), block the card with that reason; do not rewrite the fix from scratch.
